title: DS conversions — the `::` operator
preamble:
# DS conversions — the `::` operator

**Prefix `LCST`.** The postfix conversion operator `::`: its surface and precedence,
how totality and fallibility are encoded in the result type, the `?`-presence rule,
and the closed table of defined `(source, target)` conversions.

**Paired with:** identifiers over Unicode — [LNAM]; positional type
classification and the **type namespace** a cast target resolves in — [LGRA];
the lexer realization of the `NAME` / `TYPE_SYM` terminals — [LLEX]. This doc
owns `LCST.4`.

**Depends on:** [LNUL] (a fallible `::T?` is a `T?` producer feeding the
null stack), [LDET.3.2.7] (the canonical `Float`-to-text form),
[LUNI.8.5] (the unit-assertion / dimension-strip casts),
[LOPQ.4.3] (the opaque seal a cast must honour), [LEXP] (where `::` sits among the operators).
